text:
maria.p: Quick sync — post-launch decision needed. We shipped 1.0 yesterday. Two asks surfaced from enterprise beta: (1) tokenization edge-case causing occasional truncated outputs on long conversations (INF-412), and (2) onboarding prompt templating UX that reduces support tickets (UX-129). Limited engineering bandwidth. Thoughts on which to prioritize for the next minor?

aj: I'm +1 on tokenization bug. It's causing 0.4% failure on long sequences; enterprise customers hit it and escalate. Also it's a quality/regression risk.

charles: Can we quantify impact? p50 p99? If it's hitting retries and costing us, prioritize fix.

tess: From eval runs, INF-412 only triggers on sequences >4096 tokens with mixed unicode. Rare but high severity: produces hallucinated IDs. We flagged 3 customer incidents overnight.

katie: UX-129 reduces CS volume by ~15% based on our pilot. Less severe but lowers MTT (mean time to value) and improves conversion.

maria.p: Quick numbers — telemetry shows 0.4% error rate overall, but 3% on enterprise cohort. Cost impact = ~2% increase in token usage due to retries. Query I used:

``
SELECT cohort, count(*) FILTER (WHERE token_truncation=true) / count(*) AS rate
FROM inference.requests
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY cohort;
``

aj: If fix reduces retries we save tokens and reduce incidents. Estimate: 20-30% reduction in retries for affected flows.

charles: Risk of fix — touches tokenizer library used across variants. Need a canary and regression tests for other models. ETA: 3 dev-days + 1 canary/QA day.

tess: UX change ETA: 5 dev-days + design polish. Lower infra risk.

maria.p: Proposal: Patch tokenization bug as a hotfix with gated rollout to enterprise customers first (canary), and schedule UX-129 in the next minor if hotfix is higher burn than expected. Votes?

aj: :thumbsup: for hotfix canary-first.

katie: :+1: canary and then UX in next sprint if all good.

charles: I'll own canary. I'll add a rollout policy: start with 2 enterprise orgs, monitor token_truncation and p99 latency for 24h.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy INF-412 hotfix started for orgs: acme-corp, beaconio at 2026-03-23T10:12:00Z. Watch channels: #eng-runtime, #product.

maria.p: Great. Action items:
- aj: implement fix + unit tests (3d)
- charles: rollout plan + dashboards (1d)
- tess: run regression evals on top 5 open models (1d)
- katie: keep UX-129 in backlog for next minor and draft success metrics

aj: I'll open a PR and link it: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/512

charles: Dashboard links: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/inf-hotfix

maria.p: If canary is green in 36h we ship hotfix to dedicated and hosted. If not, rollback and re-evaluate.

katie: I'll create a quick support doc to triage until fix lands.

maria.p: Thanks team — closing this thread. We'll reconvene if canary flags anything. :raised_hands:
